paragraphs: Ashyan bar Nadbakh, related by marriage to Rav Yeiva; [Bava Batra 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Batra.22b.7).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked Bavli calls Yeiva Ashyan bar Nadbakh’s father-in-law. Hyman’s wording in this entry is the broader “related by marriage.”
[Heilprin’s Nadbakh notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2600&lang=en) names Ashyan as Nadbakh’s son.
